g.text: GENERAL TOLERANCES ISO 2768-mK. DO NOT SCALE.
CONCEPT DESIGN. FICTIONAL SYSTEM. ALL DIMENSIONS FROM THE MODEL AS MEASURED.
PROPORTIONS AND MOUNT GEOMETRY FROZEN AT GATE G1
DETAILED MODEL, SEVENTEEN ASSEMBLIES, GATE G2
KNEE ANCHORS, ANKLE PADS, LOOMS REVISED. DRAWING SET ISSUED
MOUNT STOWED. DEPLOYED POSITION IN PHANTOM
DEPLOYED AT ZERO AND AT THE TRAVERSE LIMITS IN PHANTOM
THE MOUNT IS SWEPT THROUGH 79 POSES: ELEVATION -5° TO 90° AT ZERO TRAVERSE, THEN TRAVERSE ±25° AT 0° AND AT -5°.
SURFACES ARE SAMPLED AT 10 mm. REQUIRED CLEARANCE 15 mm. MINIMUM FOUND 18.0 mm.
